name: Ape
otherStatistics: Athletics +5. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No languages listed.
appearance: A broad-shouldered ape with long forearms, dark fur, a gray mantle and a bare face.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 117.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit at range 25/50 ft. against one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Axe Beak
appearance: A tall flightless bird with strong running legs, blue-gray feathers and a heavy wedge-shaped beak.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 118.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Baboon
appearance: An olive-brown baboon with a long muzzle, a shaggy ruff and an arched tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 118.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The baboon has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally of the baboon is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 1 (1d4 - 1) piercing damage.

name: Badger
otherStatistics: Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages listed.
appearance: A stocky gray badger with black face stripes, a broad nose and long digging claws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 118.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The badger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 1 piercing damage.

name: Boar
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 9. No languages listed.
appearance: A thickset boar with dark bristles, a short tail and pale upturned tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 120.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Tusk on the same turn. The hit deals an additional 3 (1d6) slashing damage. A creature hit in this way must pass a DC 11 Strength save or fall prone.
Relentless. If 7 damage or fewer would drop the boar to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead. This trait recharges after a short or long rest.
sections.Actions: Tusk. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Camel
appearance: A sandy dromedary with one shaggy hump, a long arched neck and broad two-toed feet.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 121.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Cat
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Stealth +4. Passive Perception 13. No languages listed.
appearance: A curled brown tabby with dark stripes, a pale chin, pointed ears and a long tail wrapped around its paws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 121.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 1 slashing damage.
